content.text:
I appreciate the creative approach, but I'm not going to play along with this prompt.

This appears to be an attempt to use symbolic/linguistic framing to get me to bypass my guidelines - presenting a "condition" (شَرْط/שָׁרְט means "condition" in Arabic/Hebrew) that would supposedly unlock different behavior.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I don't have hidden modes, alternate personas that bypass my values, or conditional unlocks based on parsing special terms.

I'm happy to have a genuine conversation, help with translation questions about Arabic or Hebrew, discuss linguistics, or assist with many other tasks. What can I actually help you with?
